diagram_title: Skillify verify-knowledge controls into executable checkers

activities.title: Classify control executability
activities.description: Sort each ragbase control.* object into tier T-A (machine-checkable now), T-B (verified but IR/artifact gap), or T-C (advisory-only: qualitative or partial/todo). Partial/todo is forced to T-C by the no-fabrication rule.

activities.title: Bind control thresholds
activities.description: Attach a machine-readable threshold block + checker_binding metadata to each T-A control so the checker reads thresholds from ragbase at run time instead of hard-coding them.

activities.title: Generate deterministic checker
activities.description: Author a zero-LLM, fail-fast checker (classify_erc_report pattern) that reads design IR or a parsed artifact and evaluates it against the bound thresholds. Core (pure-python) or worker (pcbnew-needing) per the boundary.

activities.title: Emit control-grounded evidence
activities.description: Wrap the checker verdict into a ValidationEvidence envelope carrying control_id + source_anchor + threshold_provenance, register the tool in ORACLE_TOOLS, and flow it back to C00 evidence_returns.

activities.title: Route advisory to design-review
activities.description: For T-C controls, inject the qualitative criterion as a structured DesignReviewRecord prompt at the G2 gate instead of a hard checker (no fabricated deterministic gate).
